note: 2022 MCM A, team 2209466 (Optimal Power Distribution of a Cyclist). 22 figures and 6 tables with a measured grid, 18 excluded measured regions. One captioned table has no measured region at all: Table 6 (p20) is typeset as running text, so it is declared here and absent from tables. Two body citations disagree with the printed numbers: 'Figures 4 and 5' names the two fit curves printed as Figures 3 and 4, and the turning force diagram is cited as 'Figure 8' but printed as Figure 9. The appendix restarts numbering at 1, so Figures 1-3 and Table 1 exist twice. The p25 appendix plate has no 'Figure N' caption: its five sub-captions and the numbered key '1.UCI Women's track map 2.Women's power output 3.Women's speed 4.5.Women's Remaining aerobic and anaerobic energy' are typed from the crop.
rules: Every figure caption sits under its frame and every table caption over its header row: no exception in 22 figures and 6 tables [caption.position].

The family mix is curves and diagrams, never a distribution summary: line 11, composite-panel 3, flowchart-or-schematic 4, map-or-plan-view 1, photo-or-raster-image 1, heatmap-or-contour 1, bar 1 [geometry.family].

A multi-panel exhibit is either one row of panels or one 3x2 grid with a shaded label band; every panel after the first is measured as its own region and excluded as a fragment of the same exhibit [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.panel_layout].
Three-dimensional drawing never appears: no surface, extrusion or perspective bar anywhere in the paper [geometry.three_d].

Tables are booktabs, full width, portrait, one or two header rows, no zebra shading, no diagonal header; the only merged cells are the course-name spanners over the two gender columns [table.rule_style] [table.merged_cells].
Units live in the row labels or in the stub column, except in the deviation table where the unit is in the header cell as W/Kg [table.units_in_header].
The citing spelling is the full capitalised 'Figure N' and 'Table N'; only the appendix drops to lowercase 'figure 1' and 'figure 2' [mention.style].
Tables are introduced by number in 4 of 6 cases and by a deictic 'the table below' in the other 2; every figure except the structure diagram is introduced by number [mention.lead_pattern].

Captions run 4 to 12 words, state the subject and never a conclusion; the longest ones are the two force-analysis diagrams, which must name the process they analyse [caption.words] [caption.concludes].
The appendix restarts figure and table numbering at 1, so Figures 1-3 and Table 1 each exist twice and are told apart only by their section path [caption.numbering] [place.section_path].

Two exhibits are cited under the wrong number in the body: 'Figures 4 and 5' for the two fit curves printed as Figures 3 and 4, and 'Figure 8' for the turning force diagram printed as Figure 9 [mention.style].
